judged.play: 100T secures a round win on Split to cut LOUD's lead to 7-2.
judged.reason: A solid round-win reaction, but he repeats this exact level of hype several times during the match.

judged.play: 100T holds A main with an Operator during a slow setup phase.
judged.line: Oh my word, how is he getting that?
judged.reason: Mostly stream commentary during a slow round setup without an impactful play.

judged.play: LOUD wins a round and celebrates on camera.
judged.line: These guys have cheats, I promise.
judged.reason: Funny sarcastic accusation, but lacks a dramatic gameplay moment from his team.

judged.play: LOUD closes out the first half 9-3, showing their players on stage.
judged.reason: Amusing reaction to LOUD taking a commanding half, but mostly banter between rounds.

judged.play: 100T executes a full Sheriff eco strategy and wins a crisp pistol/eco round.
judged.line: We gotta do this Sheriff stuff man, every time!
judged.reason: Highlights a unique strategy working perfectly, accompanied by energetic tactical appreciation.

judged.play: 100T begins an attack push while down 10-3.
judged.line: Get him out of my freaking face, bro!
judged.reason: Mid-round motivation talk with standard routine kills underneath.

judged.play: Crowd cheering and broadcast replay between rounds at 11-3.
judged.line: I can't wait for the crowd to be quiet!
judged.reason: Filler moment between rounds focusing on crowd noise rather than gameplay.

judged.play: 100T holds off match point with clutch kills on B site.
judged.reason: Good tense round win under match point pressure, but the reaction is fairly standard for him.

judged.play: Broadcast highlights LOUD's young IGL on camera during a pause.
judged.line: That's AI! That's not a human being.
judged.reason: Hilarious and memorable observation praising the opponent's young caller, though not gameplay-driven.

judged.play: 100T secures a Flawless round win to continue their comeback attempt.
judged.line: I just came from church, and I know what's possible, man!
judged.reason: Includes a hilarious and highly quotable rant following a clean Flawless round.

judged.line: We're about to Ronaldo this thing up!
judged.reason: Very brief setup clip with a funny line but no play payout.

judged.play: 100T converts a clean defense round on A site.
judged.reason: Solid standing reaction to a round win, but similar hype plays out in several other clips.

judged.play: LOUD calls a timeout as 100T builds momentum.
judged.line: Can someone throw the boys a banana or something?
judged.reason: A genuinely funny story beat reacting to the timeout and his own hunger that stands out from standard match reactions.

judged.play: 100T engages in early map positioning at 12-6.
judged.reason: Low energy clip showing standard positioning without a major play or reaction.

judged.play: 100T pulls off a dramatic retake to win their fourth straight round.
judged.line: Round after round after round after round!
judged.reason: High-energy shouting match with the broadcast commentary during a huge comeback rally.

judged.play: LOUD finishes Map 1 with a 13-7 victory.
judged.line: It's not so easy, but it's okay... we are the very best!
judged.reason: Standard post-map copium commentary as 100T loses the first map.
